description: Update Cloud Function SYSTEM_PROMPT to support new agent actions: navegar, abrir_modal, llenar_campo, confirmar. Add estadoAgente field handling and update response format to include these new action types.
steps: In functions/index.js, update the SYSTEM_PROMPT to add new valid actions: 'navegar', 'abrir_modal', 'llenar_campo', 'confirmar'. Keep all existing actions (salida, devolucion, entrada, agregar_inventario, consulta, error).

Add to the SYSTEM_PROMPT a new section === ESTADO DEL AGENTE === explaining: The field 'estadoAgente' in the request indicates the agent's current state: 'libre' (waiting for a complete command or navigation), 'en_modal' (a modal/form is currently open, user is dictating field-by-field), 'modal_tipo' indicates which modal is open (salida/entrada/devolucion/material). When estadoAgente='en_modal', interpret user speech as filling fields (llenar_campo) or confirming (confirmar).

Add to the SYSTEM_PROMPT a section === ACCIONES DE NAVEGACION === explaining: When user says 'abre inventario', 've a movimientos', 'muestra herramientas', 'abre nueva salida', etc. -> return accion='navegar' with destino field. Valid destinos: dashboard, inventario, movimientos, ordenes, responsables, consumo, kits, herramientas, importar, reportes, acerca. For 'nueva salida'/'nueva entrada'/'nueva devolucion' -> return accion='abrir_modal' with modalTipo='salida'/'entrada'/'devolucion'.

Add to the SYSTEM_PROMPT a section === LLENADO DE CAMPOS === explaining: When estadoAgente='en_modal' and user says things like 'ponle como responsable Pedro Gomez', 'frente 3B', 'agrega 50 metros de cable 12 rojo', 'nota: para el tablero del tercer piso' -> return accion='llenar_campo' with campo (which field: responsable/frente/nota/item) and valor (the value to set). For items: return campo='item' with itemNombre, itemCantidad, itemUnidad.

Add to the SYSTEM_PROMPT a section === CONFIRMACION === explaining: When user says 'listo', 'generar', 'confirmar', 'guardar', 'dale' -> return accion='confirmar'. This triggers saving whatever is in the open modal.

Add to the SYSTEM_PROMPT a section === EJECUCION DIRECTA === explaining: When estadoAgente='libre' and the command has ALL required data (material, cantidad, responsable, frente), return the action (salida/entrada/devolucion) as before. The frontend will execute it directly without confirmation.

Update the SYSTEM_PROMPT response format section to show new examples: {"accion":"navegar","destino":"inventario","mensaje":"Abri inventario"}, {"accion":"abrir_modal","modalTipo":"salida","mensaje":"Abri nueva salida. Dime el responsable."}, {"accion":"llenar_campo","campo":"responsable","valor":"Pedro Gomez","mensaje":"Listo, responsable Pedro Gomez."}, {"accion":"llenar_campo","campo":"item","itemNombre":"Cable #12 AWG Rojo","itemCantidad":50,"itemUnidad":"metro","mensaje":"Agregado 50m cable 12 rojo."}, {"accion":"confirmar","mensaje":"Generando la orden..."}

In the Cloud Function request handler (exports.asistente), add estadoAgente and modalTipo to the extracted fields from req.body: const { texto, inventario, vistaActual, estadoAgente, modalTipo } = req.body;

Add estadoAgente and modalTipo context to the system text sent to Vertex AI, similar to how vistaActual is already handled: if (estadoAgente) contextoVista += '\nEstado del agente: ' + estadoAgente + (modalTipo ? ' (modal abierto: ' + modalTipo + ')' : '');
acceptance_criteria: functions/index.js SYSTEM_PROMPT contains the new actions: navegar, abrir_modal, llenar_campo, confirmar
functions/index.js handles estadoAgente and modalTipo from req.body
The new estadoAgente context is appended to the system prompt sent to Vertex AI
The response format section shows examples of the new action types
findings: Successfully added all new agent actions to SYSTEM_PROMPT. The file passes node --check syntax verification. Added 100 lines covering: estadoAgente/modalTipo handling, navigation, modal opening, field filling, confirmation, direct execution, and updated response format examples.
